title: Words and a quiet place for a 3-year-old's upset
summary: CDC says to give a 3-year-old words for feelings, and to help with stressful feelings by a deep breath, a hug of a favorite toy, or a quiet safe place.
body: On the CDC 3-year page, one activity is to talk about the child's emotions and give words that help the child explain the feeling. Another is to help manage stressful feelings by teaching a deep breath, hugging a favorite toy, or going to a quiet safe place when upset. Those are caregiver practices on an age page. They are not presented as a treatment that replaces a conversation with a doctor when a caregiver is concerned.

sources.title: Milestones by 3 Years
